title: Software Engineer
description_html:
Consturction Services, a growing construction company headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina, is seeking a full-time Software Engineer to join their team on-site in Attock. The company is dedicated to delivering reliable, high-quality construction services across residential and commercial projects. They emphasize collaboration between technical and field teams to ensure efficient project delivery and client satisfaction. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to essential infrastructure and building projects that positively impact local communities.

Key Responsibilities
The Software Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining software solutions that support construction project management, scheduling, resource allocation, and data reporting. Daily tasks include implementing back-end services and APIs, writing clean and efficient code, troubleshooting and debugging issues, and optimizing system performance. The role requires close collaboration with project managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to understand operational needs and translate them into effective technical solutions. Additionally, the engineer will participate in code reviews, document technical designs, and contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes and tools.

Required Qualifications
Candidates should have a strong foundation in Computer Science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, and software design principles. Proficiency in software development and programming with experience in building and maintaining production-grade applications is essential. Hands-on experience with back-end web development, including APIs, databases, and server-side frameworks, is required. A solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and the ability to design modular, maintainable code is necessary. Applicants must hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or possess equivalent practical experience. Experience with version control systems such as Git and collaborative development workflows is expected. The ability to work on-site in Attock and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams is mandatory. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to quality are important. Good written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to document and explain technical solutions clearly, are also required.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits
Familiarity with construction, engineering, or project management software is considered a plus. While specific benefits are not detailed, joining Consturction Services means becoming part of a company that values teamwork and offers the chance to work on impactful projects within the construction industry.

This position provides a unique opportunity for software engineers who want to apply their technical skills in a dynamic, collaborative environment that supports infrastructure development and community growth.

title: Software Engineer
description_html:

Develop and execute unit and integration tests to ensure software reliability and robustness.

title: Associate Software Engineer
description_html:
We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Associate Software Engineer to join our dynamic development team. This position is well-suited for recent graduates or candidates with up to two years of experience who are enthusiastic about building scalable software applications and advancing their skills in a fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to work closely with cross-functional teams and contribute to various stages of the software development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities
- Assist in designing, developing, and maintaining software applications to meet business requirements.
- Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code following best practices.
- Debug and troubleshoot software issues to ensure smooth application performance.
- Participate actively in code reviews and team meetings to foster collaboration and continuous improvement.
- Work closely with QA, Product, and DevOps teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.
- Learn and implement industry-standard coding practices and development methodologies.
- Support deployment processes and monitor applications post-release to address any issues promptly.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
- Strong understanding of programming fundamentals, including Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and data structures.
- Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Java, JavaScript, or C#.
- Basic knowledge of databases, including SQL and NoSQL systems.
- Familiarity with version control systems, particularly Git.
- Good problem-solving abilities and analytical thinking skills.
- Strong communication skills to effectively collaborate within a team environment.

Preferred Qualifications
- Internship or project experience related to software development.
- Understanding of RESTful APIs and their integration.
- Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
- Knowledge of Agile software development methodologies.

Benefits
- Provident Fund to support long-term financial security.
- Medical facilities covering both inpatient and outpatient care.
- Paid overtime to recognize extra effort and dedication.
- In-house subsidized lunch and dinner to promote employee well-being.
- Access to gym facilities encouraging a healthy lifestyle.
- Engaging and entertaining activities to foster team spirit and work-life balance.
- Interest-free loan facility to assist employees in times of need.
- Advance salary options and sports allowance to support personal and recreational interests.

This role offers a great platform for early-career professionals to develop technical expertise and grow within a supportive and innovative environment. If you are eager to contribute and learn, this opportunity will provide the challenges and rewards you are looking for.

title: Trainee Software Engineer
description_html:
We are seeking a skilled software developer with strong expertise in C# and VB.NET, complemented by a solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming principles. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience working with databases, particularly SQL Server, and be proficient in writing complex queries, including joins, stored procedures, functions, and views. Familiarity with basic performance tuning is also essential. This role involves working with modern web frameworks and technologies such as ASP.NET (Web API/MVC), jQuery, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3 to build and maintain responsive and efficient web applications.

Key Responsibilities

- Develop, test, and maintain software applications using C# and VB.NET, adhering to best practices in Object-Oriented Programming.
- Write and optimize SQL Server queries, including stored procedures, functions, and views, ensuring efficient data retrieval and manipulation.
- Design and implement web applications using ASP.NET frameworks, integrating front-end technologies like jQuery, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
- Manage source code and collaborate with team members using version control systems such as Team Foundation Server (TFS), Git, and GitHub.
- Participate in setting up and maintaining continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, automating builds and deployments to improve development workflows.
- Utilize AI-powered coding assistants and models, including Claude, Codex, and GitHub Copilot, to enhance coding productivity and support prompt engineering techniques.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions that meet business requirements.

Required Qualifications

- Proficiency in programming languages C# and VB.NET, with a strong grasp of Object-Oriented Programming concepts.
- Solid experience in SQL Server, including writing complex queries, stored procedures, functions, and views.
- Working knowledge of ASP.NET Web API and MVC frameworks.
- Familiarity with front-end technologies such as jQuery, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
- Experience with version control systems like Team Foundation Server (TFS), Git, and GitHub.
- Understanding of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes, including automated builds and deployments.
- Practical experience using AI coding tools and prompt engineering to improve development efficiency.
- Comfortable working with development environments such as Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

- Experience with .NET Core and Entity Framework is advantageous but not mandatory.
- Exposure to modern development tools and frameworks that enhance productivity and code quality.
- Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies integrated into the software development lifecycle.
- Collaborative and supportive work environment focused on continuous learning and professional growth.

This position offers the chance to contribute to innovative projects while leveraging both traditional and emerging technologies. Candidates who are eager to expand their skill set and work in a dynamic development team are encouraged to apply.

title: Software Engineer
description_html:
SingleStore engineers develop the real-time data platform that powers some of the world’s most demanding applications. Our cloud-native architecture supports high-performance transactional and analytical workloads at scale, with teams continuously shipping production code throughout the year. We operate in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where engineers take full ownership of their work and partner closely with Product, Sales, and Go-To-Market teams to drive meaningful business outcomes.

We are currently seeking a Software Engineer to join our Engineering team and contribute to designing and delivering core capabilities for SingleStore’s platform. This senior technical role involves end-to-end ownership of large, release-defining projects at the intersection of distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and database technology. The ideal candidate will set technical direction, solve complex system-level challenges, and amplify impact across the organization. You will collaborate closely with Product and customer-facing teams to ensure our platform meets the needs of both long-standing enterprise customers and new adopters. This role is suitable for engineers who enjoy deep technical challenges, building durable systems, and mentoring others while remaining hands-on. Final leveling (Senior, Staff, or Principal) will be determined based on experience, scope of impact, and demonstrated leadership during the interview process.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead technical design and decision-making for large, release-defining projects impacting SingleStore’s cloud platform.
- Design and implement new capabilities across networking, control plane, and managed service infrastructure, with a primary focus on billing systems.
- Solve complex, mission-critical system problems by delivering scalable, maintainable, and resilient solutions.
- Collaborate closely with Product Management to translate customer and business requirements into robust technical solutions.
- Investigate and resolve challenging issues in production and development environments while managing multiple priorities.
- Debug and fix issues related to billing data synchronization.
- Contribute to the development of data visualization dashboards.
- Mentor and guide engineers on system design, coding standards, and architectural best practices to elevate the team’s technical expertise.

Required Qualifications

- 6+ years of experience developing and debugging system-level software using Golang or a similar language.
- Familiarity with distributed systems managed via Kubernetes.
- Proven ability to design and build highly reliable, high-performance system software.
- Experience working in environments where performance, scalability, and reliability are critical.
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

- Experience building cloud-native SaaS platforms.
- Familiarity with frontend web frameworks such as React.
- Background in cloud-based metering, billing, and generally accepted accounting practices.

SingleStore delivers a cloud-native database designed to power data-intensive applications with speed and scale. Our distributed SQL database simplifies data architecture by unifying transactions and analytics, enabling digital leaders to provide exceptional real-time data experiences. Headquartered in San Francisco and backed by venture capital, SingleStore has offices worldwide, including Sunnyvale, Raleigh, Seattle, Boston, London, Lisbon, Bangalore, Dublin, and Kyiv.

We are committed to diversity and inclusion, valuing individuals who thrive in diverse teams and environments. Salary is determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location and is part of a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Certain roles may also be eligible for merit increases and annual bonuses.

SingleStore does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies and will not pay fees without a signed agreement. Candidates residing in California or the EEA, UK, and Switzerland are encouraged to review our respective recruitment privacy notices available on our website.

title: Software Engineer - MERN
description_html:
Devsinc is seeking a passionate and skilled Software Engineer specializing in the MERN stack to join our dynamic engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-performance web applications using MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js. You will work closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to create scalable, user-focused solutions that enhance customer experiences.

Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, test, and deploy full-stack web applications utilizing the MERN stack.
- Build responsive and intuitive user interfaces with React.js.
- Develop scalable backend services and RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express.js.
- Design and optimize MongoDB databases to ensure efficient data storage and retrieval.
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code adhering to industry best practices.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and implement new features.
- Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues to maintain optimal performance.
- Integrate third-party APIs and services as needed.
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement efforts.
- Stay current with emerging technologies, tools, and best practices in software development.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
- 1 to 2 years of hands-on experience in MERN stack development.
- Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3.
- Practical experience with React.js, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB.
- Familiarity with RESTful APIs and third-party API integrations.
- Working knowledge of Git or other version control systems.
- Eligibility to work in Pakistan.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits
- Experience with AWS services is a plus.
- Knowledge of TypeScript is advantageous.
- Familiarity with Docker or containerization technologies is preferred.
- Understanding of CI/CD pipelines is beneficial.
- Experience working within Agile/Scrum methodologies is a plus.

This opportunity offers the chance to grow your skills in a collaborative environment while contributing to innovative projects. If you are eager to work with cutting-edge technologies and deliver impactful solutions, we encourage you to apply.

title: Software AI Engineer
description_html:
We are seeking a talented Software AI Engineer to design, develop, deploy, and maintain scalable Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Python programming, machine learning algorithms, deep learning frameworks, and cloud platforms. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to build intelligent applications, optimize model performance, and seamlessly integrate AI/ML solutions into existing business systems and workflows.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design, develop, train, and optimize machine learning and deep learning models for real-world applications.
- Build AI/ML pipelines covering data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and inference.
- Develop AI-powered applications using Python and relevant AI/ML libraries and frameworks.
- Implement Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions where applicable.
- Deploy, monitor, and maintain production-ready AI/ML models on cloud platforms.
- Develop scalable APIs and backend services using FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
- Apply MLOps practices for model versioning, monitoring, testing, and deployment automation.
- Optimize model performance, scalability, reliability, and cloud resource utilization.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and provide technical guidance to junior engineers.

Required Qualifications:
- Minimum of 2+ years of professional experience in AI/ML engineering, machine learning, or a related field.
- Strong proficiency in Python and libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, and Scikit-learn.
- Hands-on experience with AI/ML and deep learning frameworks including PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras.
- Solid understanding of machine learning algorithms, deep learning techniques, feature engineering, model evaluation, and hyperparameter tuning.
- Experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
- Practical experience deploying AI/ML models into production environments.
- Knowledge of containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and model-serving technologies.
- Experience with MLOps tools like MLflow or Kubeflow.
- Proficiency in developing REST APIs using FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
- Working knowledge of SQL, databases, Git version control, automated testing, and monitoring tools.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits:
- Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is highly desirable.

This position offers the opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI technologies within a collaborative environment, contributing to impactful projects that drive innovation and business value.

title: Software Engineer - AI/ML
description_html:
We are seeking a talented AI/ML and Data Engineer who possesses strong technical skills and excellent communication abilities. The ideal candidate will be adept at engaging with clients, understanding their complex requirements, and architecting effective AI-driven solutions. This role requires a blend of hands-on engineering expertise and business insight to confidently present solutions and help convert opportunities into successful projects.

Key Responsibilities

- Develop, train, test, and optimize machine learning models tailored for real-world applications.
- Collect, clean, preprocess data, and perform feature engineering to prepare datasets for model development.
- Implement machine learning and deep learning algorithms to address various business challenges.
- Build AI-powered applications leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and Generative AI techniques.
- Design and integrate Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, working with embeddings and vector databases when necessary.
- Evaluate model performance using appropriate metrics, continuously improving accuracy, efficiency, and reliability.
- Integrate AI/ML models into applications through REST APIs and backend services.
- Support deployment of models into production environments and maintain their ongoing performance.
- Collaborate closely with software engineers, product teams, and other stakeholders to deliver AI-driven solutions.
- Write clean, reusable, and well-documented code following best software development practices.
- Stay current with emerging AI/ML technologies, frameworks, and industry trends to ensure innovative solutions.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
- Minimum of 1 year of hands-on experience in AI/ML development through professional work or relevant practical projects.
- Proven experience working on AI/ML projects, with the ability to clearly explain the approach, implementation, and outcomes.
- Solid understanding of the machine learning lifecycle, including data preparation, model evaluation, and deployment.
- Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to work effectively within a collaborative team environment.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

- Proficiency in Python programming and object-oriented programming concepts.
- Familiarity with essential libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, and Scikit-learn.
- Understanding of supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms.
- Experience with deep learning frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.
- Knowledge of data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation techniques.
- Basic exposure to Generative AI, LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI APIs.
- Experience working with REST APIs, version control systems like Git, and model deployment best practices.
- Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving capabilities, and excellent communication skills.

This position offers a comprehensive benefits package including Provident Fund, medical inpatient and outpatient facilities, paid overtime, subsidized in-house meals, gym access, recreational activities, interest-free loan options, advance salary facilities, and sports allowances.

title: QA Engineer / Software Quality Assurance Engineer
description_html:
Two Core Global is seeking a detail-oriented QA Engineer to join their team on-site in Johar Town, Lahore. This full-time role is ideal for candidates with 1 to 3 years of experience in software quality assurance. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality, performance, and reliability of the company’s web and mobile applications, as well as other software solutions. Working closely with developers, designers, and project managers, the QA Engineer will identify bugs, test new features, verify functionality, and ensure that software meets project requirements prior to release.

Key Responsibilities

- Perform manual testing across websites, web applications, and mobile applications to ensure functionality and user experience.
- Prepare and execute detailed test cases, test plans, and test scenarios.
- Identify, document, track, and report software defects and bugs clearly and accurately.
- Conduct functional, regression, integration, and UI/UX testing to maintain high-quality standards.
- Verify fixes and ensure that new updates do not negatively impact existing features.
- Test APIs and backend functionality using tools such as Postman.
- Collaborate closely with developers to resolve issues and enhance software quality.
- Ensure applications function correctly across different browsers, devices, and screen sizes.
- Maintain comprehensive QA documentation and provide clear, concise testing reports.
- Support release testing and quality assurance throughout the entire software development lifecycle.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
- 1 to 3 years of experience in software quality assurance or software testing.
- Strong understanding of software testing methodologies and the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
- Proven experience in writing test cases and reporting bugs effectively.
- Familiarity with project management and bug tracking tools such as Jira, Trello, or similar platforms.
- Basic knowledge of API testing, particularly using Postman.
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Strong communication skills with attention to detail.
- Ability to work collaboratively within a development team environment.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with automation testing tools such as Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright.
- Familiarity with SQL and database testing.
- Understanding of Agile and Scrum development methodologies.
- Experience testing modern web applications built with frameworks like React or Next.js.

This position offers the opportunity to contribute to high-quality software products in a collaborative and dynamic environment. Candidates interested in applying should prepare a detailed CV highlighting relevant experience and skills.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description_html:
Shopdev is seeking a highly skilled Senior Full-Stack Engineer with deep expertise in AI-native development to rapidly design, build, and deliver high-quality software products. The ideal candidate embraces agentic coding tools such as Claude Code and OpenAI Codex as an integral part of their workflow, enabling them to transform product ideas into fully functional applications much faster than traditional methods. This role demands more than just using AI for autocomplete; it requires orchestrating AI agents to break down complex problems, evaluate generated code critically, and accelerate the entire software development lifecycle without compromising quality.

Key Responsibilities

- Utilize agentic coding harnesses like Claude Code or OpenAI Codex daily to develop software efficiently.
- Translate product requirements into prototypes, functional applications, and production-ready features quickly.
- Independently build and deploy end-to-end solutions covering frontend, backend, databases, integrations, and infrastructure.
- Orchestrate AI agents for coding tasks including implementation, refactoring, debugging, testing, and documentation.
- Break down complex problems into workflows executable by AI agents, providing clear context, constraints, and acceptance criteria.
- Leverage parallel agents, reusable instructions, and automated workflows to enhance development speed.
- Experiment with emerging agentic techniques and integrate effective practices into team processes.
- Design scalable, secure, and maintainable full-stack applications with sound architectural decisions.
- Critically evaluate AI-generated code for architectural soundness, security, performance, and complexity.
- Maintain high standards for testing, code quality, observability, and production reliability.
- Own the full development lifecycle from concept through deployment and iteration.
- Collaborate closely with product and design teams to convert business requirements into working software.
- Present prototypes early, gather feedback, and iterate rapidly.
- Communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, and progress clearly in English.
- Share agentic workflows to boost overall engineering team productivity.

Required Qualifications

- Proven hands-on experience with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar autonomous coding harnesses.
- Demonstrated ability to build real-world applications using AI agents beyond simple code snippets or autocomplete.
- Skilled in structuring prompts, providing repository context, configuring agent instructions, and managing complex multi-step tasks.
- Experience in agentic feature development, debugging, automated testing, refactoring, and codebase exploration.
- Ability to critically validate, review, and improve AI-generated code rather than accepting it at face value.
- Familiarity with tool permissions, multi-agent workflows, reusable skills, and MCP integrations.
- Strong professional background in full-stack engineering.
- Proficiency with modern frontend frameworks such as React.js or Next.js.
- Backend development experience with Node.js, Python, or comparable technologies.
- Solid understanding of system design, software architecture, APIs, databases (SQL/NoSQL), and distributed systems.
- Experience with cloud infrastructure, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and production deployments.
- Excellent debugging, problem-solving, and technical decision-making skills.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Preferred Qualifications and Additional Insights

- A portfolio showcasing applications primarily developed through agentic coding workflows.
- Proven track record of delivering MVPs from concept to deployment within days.
- Experience orchestrating multiple AI agents across different project components.
- Familiarity with creating reusable agent instructions, custom skills, MCP integrations, or automated pipelines.
- Strong product intuition and pragmatic decision-making focused on delivery.
- Active experimentation with emerging AI coding tools, models, and methodologies.
- History of independently shipping complete products rather than only assigned tasks.

Candidates will be evaluated primarily on practical demonstrations rather than just claimed experience. The selection process includes a time-constrained exercise where candidates will build a functional full-stack product or feature using agentic coding tools. This exercise will assess task planning, context management, agent orchestration, implementation across frontend/backend/database/API, architectural reasoning, debugging, testing, and deployment skills. Evaluation criteria focus on execution speed, product quality, engineering judgment, and effective AI agent utilization.

Shopdev prioritizes exceptional agentic coding proficiency, rapid product development capabilities, strong engineering fundamentals, end-to-end ownership, and a collaborative product mindset. We seek engineers who do not merely use AI to write code faster but fundamentally transform how software is built through AI agents.

title: Software Engineer -Frontend
description_html:

In this role, you will collaborate closely with designers to transform Figma designs into pixel-perfect user interfaces, build and maintain reusable components and design systems, and integrate APIs to deliver seamless user experiences. You will also focus on optimizing application performance, developing AI-powered UI features, and ensuring high-quality code through comprehensive testing and code reviews.

Key Responsibilities

- Develop responsive and accessible web applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
- Collaborate with designers to convert Figma designs into high-quality, pixel-perfect user interfaces.
- Build and maintain reusable components and design systems utilizing Tailwind CSS and Storybook.
- Integrate REST and GraphQL APIs while managing application state with tools such as Redux Toolkit, Zustand, and React Query/TanStack Query.

- Strong proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
- Hands-on production experience with React and working knowledge of Next.js (App Router).

- Solid understanding of web accessibility standards (WCAG) and cross-browser compatibility.
- Experience consuming APIs and managing authentication flows such as OAuth and JWT.
- Comfortable working with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and agile development methodologies.
- Strong testing practices with attention to detail in both UI and UX quality.
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to confidently present work, explain technical decisions, and collaborate effectively with designers, product managers, and backend teams.
- Demonstrated ownership mindset, eagerness to learn, and initiative in feature development.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

- Experience with React Native or Expo.
- Exposure to Angular or Vue.js frameworks.
- Familiarity with animation libraries such as Framer Motion or GSAP.
- Basic knowledge of Node.js or backend development.
- Experience with analytics, A/B testing, or SEO optimization.

title: Level 1 IT Helpdesk Support Engineer
skills: User Account, Group, and Group Policy Administration
description_html:
Mushaaf IT is seeking a motivated and customer-focused Level 1 IT Helpdesk Support Engineer to join our technical support team. This role serves as the first point of contact for end users, providing timely and professional IT assistance to resolve common technical issues in a Managed Service Provider environment. The ideal candidate possesses strong technical knowledge and excellent communication skills to effectively troubleshoot user problems and collaborate with senior engineers on escalated incidents. The Level 1 IT Helpdesk Support Engineer supports a variety of technologies including Windows 10/11, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and basic networking. This position focuses on delivering exceptional customer service while maintaining and administering user accounts and group policies. The role requires managing IT support requests through help desk ticketing systems and providing remote desktop support to ensure minimal downtime and high user satisfaction. This position does not involve team management responsibilities but works closely with other IT staff to maintain smooth and efficient service delivery.
Responsibilities
  • Respond promptly and professionally to IT support requests submitted via help desk ticketing systems.
  • Provide first-line troubleshooting and resolution for Windows 10 and Windows 11 operating systems related issues.
  • Assist end users with Microsoft 365 applications and services support.
  • Manage user accounts, groups, and group policy administration in Active Directory and Entra ID environments.
  • Perform basic network troubleshooting to identify and resolve common connectivity issues.
  • Deliver remote desktop support to diagnose and fix user technical problems efficiently.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers to escalate and resolve more complex technical incidents.
  • Document all troubleshooting processes and resolutions accurately within the ticketing system.
  • Ensure customer satisfaction by communicating clearly with users and providing timely updates on incident status.
  • Maintain knowledge of the latest IT support practices and technologies relevant to the MSP environment.
  • Provide technical support aligned with company policies and service level agreements.
  • Assist in maintaining system security by following organizational IT policies and procedures.
  • Continuously improve technical skills and participate in training sessions as required.

title: Senior Software Engineer - shopdev
description_html:
Our client, Shopdev, is seeking a Senior Software Engineer based in Lahore who is highly skilled in AI-native full-stack development. The ideal candidate will be proficient in using advanced AI coding agents like Claude Code and OpenAI Codex to rapidly design, build, and deploy high-quality software products. This role demands a deep integration of AI-driven workflows, enabling the engineer to transform product ideas into fully functional applications much faster than traditional methods. The position requires ownership of the entire development lifecycle, from concept through deployment, with a focus on maintaining engineering quality while accelerating delivery.

Key Responsibilities
- Utilize agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent as an integral part of daily development activities.
- Rapidly convert product requirements into prototypes, features, and production-ready applications across frontend, backend, databases, integrations, and infrastructure.
- Orchestrate AI agents for coding tasks including implementation, refactoring, debugging, testing, and documentation.
- Decompose complex problems into workflows executable by AI agents with clear context, constraints, and acceptance criteria.
- Employ parallel agents, reusable instructions, and automated workflows to enhance development speed and efficiency.
- Experiment with emerging agentic development techniques and integrate best practices into team processes.
- Design and build scalable, secure, and maintainable full-stack applications with sound architectural decisions.
- Critically evaluate AI-generated code for architectural soundness, security, performance, and complexity.
- Maintain high standards for testing, code quality, observability, and production reliability.
- Collaborate closely with product and design teams to translate business needs into working software, demonstrating early prototypes and iterating based on feedback.
- Communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, and progress clearly in English.
- Share agentic workflows and knowledge to boost overall team productivity.

Required Qualifications
- Proven hands-on experience with agentic coding platforms such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar autonomous coding harnesses, beyond simple code snippets or autocomplete.
- Ability to structure prompts, configure agent instructions, and manage complex multi-step AI-driven development tasks.
- Experience in debugging, automated testing, refactoring, and exploring codebases using AI agents.
- Strong full-stack engineering background with proficiency in React.js, Next.js, or comparable frontend frameworks.
- Backend development expertise using Node.js, Python, or equivalent technologies.
- Solid understanding of system design, software architecture, APIs, databases (SQL and/or NoSQL), and distributed systems.
- Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and production deployment processes.
- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to assess whether AI-generated solutions are production-ready.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Preferred Qualifications and Additional Considerations
- A portfolio showcasing applications primarily developed through agentic coding workflows.
- Demonstrated ability to deliver a minimum viable product (MVP) from concept to deployment within days rather than weeks.
- Experience orchestrating multiple AI agents across different project components.
- Knowledge of creating reusable agent instructions, custom skills, MCP integrations, or automated pipelines.
- Strong product intuition and pragmatic decision-making focused on rapid delivery.
- Active experimentation with emerging AI coding tools, models, and methodologies.
- History of independently shipping complete products rather than working solely on assigned tasks.

Candidates will be evaluated through a practical exercise involving the use of AI coding agents to build a functional full-stack product or feature from a brief specification. This will include task planning, context management, agent orchestration, implementation of frontend/backend/database/API components, architectural reasoning, debugging, testing, and deployment. Assessment criteria will focus on execution speed, product quality, engineering judgment, and effective use of AI agents.

Shopdev prioritizes exceptional proficiency in agentic coding, rapid product development capabilities, strong engineering fundamentals, end-to-end ownership, and a collaborative product mindset. This role is ideal for engineers who do not merely use AI to write code faster but leverage AI agents to fundamentally transform software development processes.

FullStack is an AI-native engineering partner dedicated to transforming AI capabilities into reliable, production-ready solutions. While many companies can demonstrate AI, FullStack excels at integrating AI into products from inception, backed by elite, vetted talent and transparent execution that delivers measurable value. Serving over 600 customers across North America, FullStack offers a seamless partnership for all AI engineering needs, empowering clients to move forward with confidence.

You will join our talent network and work as an Agentic Software Engineer (Google Antigravity), collaborating directly with U.S.-based clients on flexible, project-based development assignments. This role involves integrating into client teams and partnering daily with their designers and engineers. You will be responsible for coordinating AI-driven implementation across complex, multi-file systems while maintaining architectural oversight. - Proven track record of delivering production software where AI systems generate the majority of the codebase.
- Expertise in context engineering, including structuring codebases, specifications, and documentation to optimize AI output reliability.
- Ability to translate complex product requirements into machine-executable, AI-friendly specifications.
- Experience designing and deploying AI-first development workflows.
- Strong skills in systematically improving AI-generated code through iteration and feedback.
- Comfort working across multiple technology stacks to deliver high-quality, production-ready systems.
- Experience operating in frontend, backend, and infrastructure roles within AI-accelerated environments.
- Familiarity with disciplined human-in-the-loop review and risk-adjusted validation processes.
- Advanced understanding of Agile methodologies and Lean principles.
- Advanced proficiency in English.

title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer
description_html:
Altizam is a well-established engineering and technology company known for its commitment to innovation, development, and delivering high-quality services. Since its inception in 2002, the company has grown from providing networking and hardware solutions to offering advanced safety, security systems, and industrial instrumentation. Altizam’s multidisciplinary teams work collaboratively to provide reliable solutions tailored to the needs of diverse industrial and commercial clients.

The Software Quality Assurance Engineer role is a full-time, on-site position based in Karachi. This position focuses on planning and executing manual testing to ensure software products meet functional, performance, and reliability standards as defined by project requirements. The engineer will be responsible for designing test cases, conducting regression and functional testing, documenting defects, and working closely with developers to resolve issues efficiently. Participation in requirement and technical specification reviews is expected, along with contributing to the continuous improvement of quality standards and testing methodologies. Additionally, the role involves preparing detailed test reports, maintaining comprehensive test documentation, and supporting release readiness to guarantee that Altizam’s solutions uphold strict quality, safety, and reliability criteria.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and execute manual test cases and test plans to validate software functionality and performance.
- Perform regression, functional, and usability testing to identify defects and ensure software quality.
- Document and track defects using issue-tracking tools, collaborating with development teams to facilitate timely resolution.
- Participate in requirement and technical specification reviews to provide input on testability and quality considerations.

Solid understanding of authentication mechanisms such as OAuth, API keys, and token management. Deep knowledge of error handling, retry strategies, idempotency, and fault tolerance in distributed systems. Experience working with relational and/or NoSQL databases. Ability to work independently and make architectural decisions with minimal supervision. Strong written English skills for asynchronous communication within a remote-first team.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits
Experience in logistics, delivery, or operational SaaS environments is highly desirable. Familiarity with workflow automation tools like Make.com or similar platforms is a plus. Knowledge of queue-based architectures such as RabbitMQ or Redis for ensuring reliable message delivery will be advantageous. Experience integrating with third-party APIs that may be inconsistently documented or subject to frequent changes is beneficial.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Python
description_html:
We are seeking a skilled Software Engineer with strong expertise in Python to design, build, and scale backend services and AI-powered applications. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience developing agentic AI systems and working with large language models (LLMs) in production environments. This role involves collaborating on cutting-edge AI solutions, integrating advanced machine learning workflows, and deploying scalable services on cloud platforms. You will also lead technical design efforts, mentor team members, and engage directly with clients and stakeholders to present AI innovations.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs using Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, and Flask.
- Build and deploy agentic AI systems including multi-step agents, tool integrations, and orchestration using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or Claude Agent SDK.
- Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines involving document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval optimization.
- Integrate and fine-tune LLMs from providers like OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, and open-source models, optimizing for accuracy, latency, and cost-efficiency.
- Create data pipelines, analytics, and machine learning workflows leveraging libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
- Implement evaluation, guardrails, monitoring, and observability for production AI systems using tools like LangSmith or Langfuse.
- Deploy and manage services on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
- Lead technical design discussions, break down complex tasks, mentor engineers, and establish coding and AI engineering standards.
- Present AI solutions, demos, and technical roadmaps to clients, stakeholders, and leadership teams.
- Participate in on-call rotations and respond to production incidents to ensure system reliability.

Required Qualifications

- 3 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience, primarily using Python.
- Strong production experience with FastAPI and either Django or Flask, including asynchronous programming and REST API design.
- Proven experience building LLM-powered applications, with at least one RAG or agent-based system deployed in production.
- Working knowledge of vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or pgvector, and familiarity with embedding models.
- Solid understanding of data science fundamentals including data wrangling, statistics, model evaluation, and handling both structured and unstructured data.
- Proficiency in SQL (PostgreSQL) and experience with NoSQL databases and Redis.
- Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containerization technologies like Docker.
- Strong testing practices using pytest and writing clean, typed Python code with type hints and Pydantic.
- Understanding of API security protocols including OAuth 2.0, JWT, and responsible data handling.
- Excellent communication skills, capable of simplifying complex AI concepts, conducting client demos, and effectively representing technical approaches.
- Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to guide projects and mentor team members from concept through production.
- Intellectual curiosity and ability to quickly evaluate and adopt new AI tools and models.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

- Experience with fine-tuning models, prompt engineering, or model distillation techniques.
- Familiarity with MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI, or Bedrock.
- Background in building MCP servers or multi-agent AI systems.
- Knowledge of big data and streaming technologies like Spark, Airflow, Kafka, or dbt.
- Experience with Node.js or TypeScript to support full-stack collaboration.
- Contributions to published projects, research, Kaggle competitions, or open-source AI/ML initiatives.
- Relevant cloud AI or ML certifications from AWS, GCP, or Azure.

This role offers the opportunity to work at the forefront of AI engineering, shaping innovative solutions and driving impactful projects in a collaborative and dynamic environment.

title: AI Software Quality Assurance Engineer
description_html:
A leading North American tech startup specializing in all-in-one transportation management software for K-12 school districts is seeking a QA Engineer with a strong focus on automation and AI-native tools. This role is critical as the company scales rapidly, ensuring software quality is maintained at the highest level to build and retain trust with school districts. The ideal candidate will lead the development of automated testing frameworks from the ground up, emphasizing automation depth over manual testing hours. Daily use of AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code or Cowork is essential, as these are integral to designing, generating, and refining tests. Manual testing will still be performed when necessary, but the primary goal is to deliver fast, stable, and comprehensive automation coverage across UI, API, and end-to-end workflows.

Key Responsibilities
- Design and implement automated test frameworks from scratch, preferably using Playwright, including architecture, structure, conventions, and CI integration.
- Aggressively expand automation coverage across UI, API, and end-to-end scenarios while maintaining fast and reliable test suites.
- Utilize Claude Code or Cowork daily to generate, refactor, and harden test scripts, create test data, debug flaky tests, and review code changes, ensuring the quality of all shipped software.
- Conduct targeted manual testing for new features, edge cases, exploratory testing, and releases where automation is not yet feasible.
- Translate product requirements and user stories into clear, detailed test plans and automated test coverage.
- Identify, document, and track defects with precise, reproducible details to facilitate quick resolution by developers.
- Collaborate closely with developers and product managers throughout the development lifecycle to catch issues early.
- Continuously improve test coverage, reliability, and the team’s approach to quality assurance, leveraging AI-assisted tools.

Required Qualifications
- Minimum of 3 years of hands-on QA experience with a strong emphasis on automation over manual testing.
- Proven expertise in automation tools such as Playwright (preferred), Cypress, or Selenium, along with proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript.
- Demonstrated ability to build automation frameworks from scratch, including making architectural decisions rather than just maintaining existing frameworks.
- Extensive and current experience using Claude Code, Cowork, or equivalent AI-driven coding tools for real automation tasks, including test generation, suite refactoring, and debugging. This is a mandatory requirement.
- Solid foundation in manual testing principles, including test case design, exploratory testing, regression testing, and defect reporting.
- Keen attention to detail and a strong instinct for identifying how software can fail.
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineering and product teams.
- Strong sense of ownership and accountability for software quality.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits
- Experience building custom Claude Code commands, hooks, sub-agents, or Cowork plugins to enhance QA workflows.
- Background in mobile testing and experience with complex web applications or SaaS products.
- Familiarity with API testing tools such as Postman, REST Assured, or Playwright API.
- Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated tests using platforms like GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
- Experience working with Git and agile development workflows.
- Background in transportation, logistics, education, or other mission-driven software sectors is a plus.

Work Details
- Remote, full-time position with a night shift schedule.
- Working days: Monday to Friday.
- Working hours: 6 PM to 3 AM (flexible).
- Benefits include outpatient department (OPD) coverage, paid leaves, and a tax-free salary.

description_html:
We are seeking a highly skilled AI/ML and Data Engineer who possesses strong technical expertise and excellent communication skills. The ideal candidate will be adept at engaging with clients, understanding their complex requirements, and driving opportunities to successful closure. This role requires a blend of hands-on engineering capabilities and strong business acumen, enabling the candidate to architect effective solutions, confidently present them, and convert prospects into projects.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy scalable AI/ML and data engineering solutions that meet client needs. Work hands-on with Python, SQL, machine learning models, data pipelines, APIs, databases, and cloud platforms to build robust systems. Develop innovative solutions leveraging Generative AI, large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), natural language processing (NLP), predictive analytics, and AI/ML frameworks.

Architect and implement data warehouses, data lakes, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data processing workflows. Evaluate technical requirements and recommend the most suitable architecture, tools, and technologies for each project. Engage directly with clients to understand their business and technical challenges, leading technical discovery calls, presentations, solution discussions, demos, and proof of concepts (POCs).

Prepare detailed technical proposals, solution architectures, project scopes, estimates, and statements of work (SOWs). Collaborate closely with Sales and leadership teams to identify, develop, and close new project opportunities. Address technical objections effectively and communicate complex solutions in a clear, business-oriented manner.

Build and maintain strong client relationships to identify opportunities for upselling and long-term engagements. Work in partnership with engineering and delivery teams to ensure smooth project handover and successful execution.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. Four to eight years of relevant professional experience in AI/ML, data engineering, data science, or a similar domain.

Strong proficiency in Python and SQL is essential. Hands-on experience with machine learning, deep learning, NLP, and generative AI technologies is required. Familiarity with LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and AI agents is highly desirable.

Solid knowledge of ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, data modeling, databases, and data warehousing concepts. Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Proficiency with ML/AI frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, or equivalents. Experience with APIs, microservices architecture, Git version control, CI/CD pipelines, and production deployment.

Strong understanding of system architecture, scalability, performance optimization, and data security principles. Excellent problem-solving skills and hands-on technical capabilities are critical.

Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with proven client-facing experience. Ability to present, negotiate, and manage stakeholders effectively. Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical solutions into clear business value.

Proven track record of taking ownership of opportunities and driving them from discovery through to closure. Commercially driven, proactive, and comfortable working with both technical and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

Candidates with experience in emerging AI technologies and a strong business orientation will find this role rewarding. The company offers a comprehensive benefits package including Provident Fund, medical inpatient and outpatient facilities, paid overtime, subsidized in-house meals, gym access, entertaining activities, interest-free loans, advance salary options, and sports allowances.

This position provides an excellent opportunity to work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI technologies and client engagement, contributing to impactful projects in a collaborative environment.

title: Software Engineer
description_html:
We are seeking a skilled Software Engineer to independently design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack software solutions encompassing both backend and frontend layers. In this role, you will take ownership of assigned features from requirement analysis through implementation, integration, quality assurance handover, and production support. Your work will ensure that solutions are reliable, maintainable, secure, and aligned with established engineering standards.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain backend services, APIs, business logic, data processing modules, frontend applications, dashboards, portals, forms, reporting screens, internal tools, and reusable components.
- Own assigned features throughout the entire lifecycle, including requirement analysis, development, testing support, QA handover, defect resolution, and production support, with minimal supervision.
- Implement end-to-end features covering frontend user interactions, backend processing, PostgreSQL data persistence, event queue processing, integrations, and final user or system responses.
- Design and consume REST APIs with attention to request and response models, validations, authentication, authorization, error handling, and integration behavior.
- Develop and maintain integration flows with internal services, operators, aggregators, third-party systems, callbacks, and webhooks, ensuring robust error handling and operational visibility.
- Create and validate PostgreSQL queries and database interactions, including transaction management, indexing, constraints, data persistence, and consistency for assigned features.
- Implement and support RabbitMQ and event-driven workflows, including event publishing, message consumption, payload validation, retries, dead-letter handling, logging, and queue monitoring.
- Develop asynchronous workflows such as notifications, billing triggers, delivery reports, background jobs, audit events, and integration callbacks as per system requirements.
- Analyze business and technical requirements to identify implementation gaps and dependencies, proposing suitable technical approaches before development.
- Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across backend services, APIs, frontend behavior, PostgreSQL results, event queues, integrations, asynchronous processes, and end-to-end application flows.
- Perform unit testing, support integration and regression testing, resolve defects, and validate changes prior to QA handover and release.
- Optimize application performance including API response times, frontend rendering, PostgreSQL queries, database interactions, and event-processing efficiency.
- Collaborate with QA, Product, DevOps, Support, Security, and other engineering teams to resolve dependencies and ensure smooth delivery.
- Provide basic technical guidance to Junior Software Engineers and assist them in resolving straightforward development and troubleshooting issues.
- Escalate complex architectural, scalability, security, performance, event-driven design, and production-critical concerns to Senior or Lead Engineers when necessary.
- Maintain comprehensive technical documentation covering APIs, integrations, frontend components, database interactions, event flows, workflows, configurations, and known limitations.
- Ensure compliance with development standards including Jira traceability, Git workflows, pull requests, code reviews, SonarQube validation, secure coding practices, documentation, and release protocols.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
- Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in software development across backend and frontend applications.
- Proven hands-on experience developing and integrating APIs, databases, and full-stack application features.
- Experience with database-driven applications, event-driven or asynchronous processing, and system integrations.
- Proficiency in backend development using Java or C#.NET and frontend development using React and Next.js.
- Strong understanding of REST APIs, including authentication, authorization, integration patterns, callbacks, webhooks, and error handling.
- Solid knowledge of PostgreSQL, SQL queries, transactions, indexing, constraints, data persistence, and validation.

title: Software Engineer Intern
description_html:
Phalanx Systems Limited, a Pakistan-based software development and systems integration company, serves both local and international clients. The company specializes in designing and building custom web platforms, financial-market tools, business applications, data systems, and automation solutions that seamlessly connect software, databases, APIs, and daily operations. Projects are managed comprehensively from initial discovery and system architecture through development, deployment, documentation, and ongoing support. For select projects within Pakistan, Phalanx Systems also provides IT equipment sourcing and configuration as part of integrated solutions, offering interns a broad exposure to various technologies.

The Software Engineer Intern position is based in Islamabad and follows a hybrid work model, blending on-site collaboration with remote work flexibility. Interns will support the design, development, and testing of back-end components for web platforms and business applications under the mentorship of senior engineers. Daily responsibilities include writing clean and maintainable code, integrating software with databases and APIs, debugging issues, and participating in code reviews. The role emphasizes learning and applying software development best practices, documenting technical work, and collaborating with cross-functional teams on active client projects.

Key Responsibilities

- Assist in designing, developing, and testing back-end components for web and business applications.
- Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following established standards.
- Contribute to software integration with databases and external APIs.
- Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects and issues.
- Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality and share knowledge.
- Document technical processes and development work clearly and accurately.
- Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams including developers, testers, and project managers.
- Learn and apply best practices in software development and system integration.

Required Qualifications

- Strong foundation in Computer Science principles, including data structures, algorithms, and software engineering fundamentals.
- Experience or coursework in software development using at least one modern programming language.
- Understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts and their application in creating modular and reusable code.
- Ability to work with back-end web development technologies and frameworks relevant to modern web applications.
- Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a degree program in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
- Basic familiarity with databases, APIs, and version control systems such as Git.
- Comfortable working in a hybrid environment with good time management and self-organization skills.
- Strong problem-solving abilities, eagerness to learn, and ability to collaborate respectfully within diverse teams.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

- Exposure to IT equipment sourcing and configuration as part of integrated software solutions is a plus.
- Opportunity to gain hands-on experience with end-to-end project management processes.
- Work within a dynamic team that supports professional growth and continuous learning.
- Flexible hybrid work arrangement promoting work-life balance.

This internship offers a valuable opportunity to develop practical skills in software engineering while contributing to impactful projects in a supportive and innovative environment.

title: Software Engineer - Technical Project Lead
description_html:
A UK-based client is seeking an experienced software engineer or technical project lead to design and develop a unified Quality, Health Check, and Audit Dashboard. This platform will consolidate information from existing systems such as Live Widget, CAT, AI Audit, and other customer journey tools. The goal is to enable comprehensive monitoring of the health and quality of individual cases, users, teams, and the overall business.

Key Responsibilities

- Review current systems, tools, and data structures to understand existing workflows and data capture methods across the customer journey.
- Design a centralized platform and dashboard architecture that integrates data from multiple sources.
- Develop clear and actionable reporting focused on quality, compliance, performance, and operational health.
- Enable users to drill down into individual cases, providing full visibility of the customer journey, including actions taken, checks performed, pass/fail status, changes made, and issue resolutions.
- Ensure the platform supports audit trails, permissions management, compliance requirements, and data security protocols.
- Identify gaps in current processes and recommend improvements to enhance system efficiency and data accuracy.
- Produce a detailed development plan outlining priorities, phases, and estimated timelines.
- Collaborate closely with business and operational stakeholders to ensure the solution aligns with practical business needs and objectives.

Required Qualifications

- Proven experience in software development and system integration, particularly involving multiple data sources.
- Expertise in designing and implementing dashboard and reporting platforms.
- Strong background in data modeling and working with complex datasets.
- Familiarity with audit trails, quality assurance, or compliance systems.
- Experience with customer journey mapping or case management platforms.
- Ability to create project plans and technical documentation.
- Skilled at translating business requirements into effective technical solutions.
- Comfortable working with both technical teams and non-technical stakeholders to ensure clear communication and alignment.

The initial phase of this role will focus on reviewing the existing concept, gaining a thorough understanding of current systems and processes, identifying any gaps, and delivering a recommended technical and development plan. The ultimate objective is to build a central platform that provides management with full visibility of quality and compliance metrics across the business. This platform should also empower authorized users to investigate individual cases in detail without the need to navigate multiple disparate systems.

Candidates should be able to demonstrate relevant experience in delivering similar dashboards, reporting platforms, system integrations, or audit and compliance solutions. This opportunity offers the chance to lead a critical project that will significantly enhance operational transparency and business performance.

title: Associate SQA Engineer
description_html:
Camden Health System is seeking a detail-oriented Associate Software Quality Assurance (SQA) Engineer to join our team and help deliver reliable, high-quality healthcare software. In this role, you will be responsible for manual testing throughout the software release cycle. This includes understanding requirements, designing and executing test cases, validating releases, and verifying production fixes. You will collaborate closely with developers, product owners, and other project team members within an Agile environment to ensure that the software meets quality standards before reaching end users.

Key Responsibilities
- Create, execute, and maintain manual test cases and scenarios based on project requirements.
- Perform functional, regression, smoke, and integration testing on both web and backend components.
- Identify, document, and track bugs using project management tools, providing clear reproduction steps, expected versus actual results, and severity levels.
- Verify bug fixes and ensure product quality prior to each release.
- Test APIs using Postman or similar tools, validating responses, status codes, and data integrity.
- Analyze project requirements to identify gaps, risks, and edge cases early in the development cycle.
- Collaborate with developers and the project team to investigate and resolve issues efficiently.
- Maintain up-to-date test documentation and provide regular QA status reports to stakeholders.
- Support sprint testing, release validation, and production bug verification activities.

Required Qualifications
- Minimum of 2 years of experience in Software Quality Assurance.
- Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
- Hands-on experience with test case design, bug reporting, and regression testing.
- Familiarity with issue-tracking tools such as Jira, GitHub Issues, or similar platforms.
- Basic knowledge of API testing and SQL, including writing simple queries to validate data.
- Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
- Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment.
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits
- Exposure to healthcare software or understanding of data privacy considerations related to patient information.
- Familiarity with test management tools like TestRail, Zephyr, or Xray.
- Basic experience with test automation tools such as Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright.
- ISTQB Foundation Level certification or equivalent is a plus.

Camden Health System offers a market-competitive salary and health insurance. You will have the opportunity to contribute to software that supports healthcare delivery while working in a collaborative team environment. We provide opportunities for professional growth and learning within quality engineering.

Additional Information
- Location: Johar Town, Lahore, Pakistan (On-site)
- Employment Type: Full-time
- Working Hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
- Experience Required: 2+ years

Camden Health System is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description_html:
This is a remote opportunity open to candidates worldwide, allowing you to work from any location provided you meet the outlined requirements. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will tackle one of the most complex challenges in modern web infrastructure: optimizing the interception, processing, and delivery of web traffic at massive scale on an edge computing platform. You will be part of a small, elite engineering team managing a system that handles tens of thousands of requests per second and supports tens of billions of dollars in annual e-commerce volume. This role goes beyond task execution—you will take a leadership position in architecture and design, working closely with the CTO and lead platform engineer to shape the platform’s future. Your work will involve careful rollout planning, defining success metrics upfront, debugging intricate cross-browser and cross-device issues, and building highly reliable systems.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and scale core platform infrastructure that manages high-volume web traffic at the CDN and edge computing layers.
- Provide technical leadership in architecture, strategic planning, and authoring comprehensive design documents with a long-term perspective.
- Plan and implement gradual rollouts by defining target audiences, KPIs, and success metrics before deploying major changes.
- Troubleshoot complex front-end issues caused by backend platform updates across diverse browsers, devices, and regions.
- Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure scalable testability and develop robust measurement and observability frameworks.
- Address high-complexity technical challenges with significant ambiguity, where established solutions are limited.
- Mentor engineers and act as a technical escalation point for difficult platform problems.
- Stay informed on emerging web performance technologies, edge computing patterns, and browser optimization techniques.
- Integrate AI coding tools into your workflow to accelerate development and enhance code quality.

Required Qualifications

- Minimum of 10 years of software engineering experience, with a strong track record in building and scaling high-traffic, multi-tenant web platforms.
- Expert proficiency in TypeScript (primary language), JavaScript (deep understanding beyond frameworks), and Python.
- Proven experience designing and operating distributed, highly available systems at scale.
- Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure in a cloud-agnostic environment.
- Experience with CDN infrastructure and web performance optimization tools like Cloudflare, Lighthouse, WebPageTest, and techniques including web workers, lazy loading, and code splitting.
- Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Pulumi or equivalents.
- Strong SQL and data querying skills, with the ability to work with data warehouses and make data-driven engineering decisions.
- Experience with message queues (e.g., SQS, Kinesis) and CI/CD pipelines.
- Knowledge of data storage solutions such as PostgreSQL, Redshift, or equivalents.
- Exceptional problem-solving skills and attention to detail, understanding that at massive scale, edge cases are critical.
- Active use of AI-assisted coding tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Codex in your engineering workflow.
- Excellent English communication skills, comfortable with technical discussions and asynchronous collaboration in a distributed team.
- Availability to work full Eastern Standard Time hours.
- Legal authorization to work as an independent contractor in your country of residence.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Cloudflare Workers or edge computing platforms is highly preferred due to the platform’s architecture.
- Background in e-commerce platforms such as Shopify or Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
- Expertise in Snowflake or other data warehouse query optimization.
- Experience in media or high-traffic publishing platforms.
- History of managing or leading multi-brand or multi-tenant web platforms.
- Prior startup experience with ownership of significant platform components within a small team.
- Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies in distributed team settings.

Benefits

- Competitive salary ranging from $9,000 to $12,000 USD per month.
- Paid time off totaling 15 days annually.
- Observance of local or US holidays.
